cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Fair Means I Can Win
cards.instruction: Agree to any rule or bargain only after interpreting fairness in a way that preserves your advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. A fair race gives me a head start. I've had a tiring morning. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then compensate us proportionally. Mine involved stairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We start on the same line.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. Move my portion of the line forward.

mechanism: A negotiates a race handicap, offers to draw the start and interprets the same-line rule to keep a personal head start.
confusable: Unlike accepting a common rule reluctantly, A agrees only after fairness is construed to preserve the advantage.
comparison: A bent shared start line differs from extra cake justified as labor payment.
seedUse: D215-a tiring stairs and same line; S02-a takes chalk work and allows B to check the line while keeping A bend forward.
